title: NLS Finland building footprints with geometry overviews
description: Building footprints from the National Land Survey of Finland topographic database (Maastotietokanta, rakennus feature class), published as a cloud-native GeoParquet with precomputed geometry overviews. 5.65 million rows in ETRS89 / TM35FIN (EPSG:3067), one row per building per overview band. A real dataset carrying a full OSI semantic model, see nls-buildings.osi.yaml next to this file.

osi:metrics.name: building_count
osi:metrics.description: Number of distinct buildings, counted once regardless of overview band.

osi:metrics.name: avg_floor_count
osi:metrics.description: Average floor count code across buildings at band 0.

osi:metrics.name: total_footprint_area_m2
osi:metrics.description: Total building footprint area in square meters, computed on the original band 0 geometries in EPSG:3067.

table:columns.name: OGC_FID
table:columns.description: Sequential feature identifier assigned during conversion.

table:columns.name: mtk_id
table:columns.description: Persistent feature identifier in the NLS topographic database.

table:columns.name: sijaintitarkkuus

table:columns.name: aineistolahde

table:columns.name: alkupvm

table:columns.name: korkeustarkkuus

table:columns.name: geometry

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
